scope: Independent agent review of each full five-language season source, including reading passages, grounded questions, writing tasks and model answers. This is editorial review, not external linguistic certification or full-film listening.

seasons.method: Independent full-field source review; exact repeated model/translation values and canonical quiz instructions were equality-checked before deduplicated display. Author made all source edits. All requested fixes and new localized cues were reread at the final source hash.

issues.finding: The opening named equal access versus equal outcomes, but the example and model distinguished formal availability from practical access.
issues.fix: Aligned the opening, following explanation and first answer with formal availability versus practical access.

issues.finding: 内核矛盾 was an unnatural rendering of central tension in this academic context.
A familiar map symbol did not identify who was familiar with it; Japanese implied familiarity on the newcomers side, obscuring the staff/newcomer contrast.
issues.fix: Specified a map symbol familiar to staff and synchronized all four translations and display fields.

issues.finding: Live sessions were narrowed to in-person teaching in Japanese and Chinese although the source only established synchronous teaching.
issues.fix: Used リアルタイムの授業 and 同步課程/同步课程; repeated quiz translations match.

issues.finding: Generic templates did not identify the concrete language or concept being taught; repeat prompts sometimes referred to two parts without an identified two-part relation.
issues.fix: Added 24 distinct topic-specific cue sets in all five languages, at least two per episode; revised the repeat prompt to keep the key relationship or distinction clear.

issues.finding: One new cue referred to not necessarily although the demonstration used without necessarily; bare multiword metalanguage also produced awkward English verb adjacency.
issues.fix: Used a clear added-material/analysis distinction in five languages; explicitly introduced the phrase may serve in English.

issues.finding: An overall approval, literal significance wording and one Simplified character in the Traditional Chinese prompt needed cleanup.
issues.fix: Removed an, clarified explanation of the questions importance, and changed 兩项 to 兩項.

episode_review.note: Audience, evaluation criteria, required comparison and independent evidence collection align across brief, questions and action plan.
Summary versus analysis is distinguished; additional quotation alone does not establish stronger reasoning or guarantee a grade.
The meeting prioritizes conceptual scope, records prior attempts and distinguishes next steps from approval of the entire essay.
Formal availability versus practical access now matches the hypothetical clinic/bus example, reflection and evidence-based answers.
Notes separate claim, hypothetical example, explanatory link, limitation and unanswered recruitment question; staff familiarity is explicit.
The hypothetical signage pilot retains timing, competing explanations, setting and uncertainty; summary never strengthens correlation to causation.
Seminar interpretation distinguishes narrator from author, grounds a qualified reading in textual contrast, and invites counterevidence.
Disagreement accepts replay benefits while challenging universal replacement; synchronous teaching and subject-specific limits remain intact.
Feedback requests test interpretation and significance before surface editing; model revises scope without automatically accepting every suggestion.
Work dependencies, independent tasks, conditional site substitution and observation-reconciliation buffer match the reading and plan.
The instructor email identifies conflicting documents, previous checking, a narrow request and useful work possible while waiting.
The final integrated task combines qualified evidence, peer feedback and a focused instructor email using prior season concepts.

seasons.limits: Source semantic review only; no audio-pronunciation or complete encoded-video playback claim. Source-bound artwork QA follows separately.

seasons.scope: All 12 episodes: titles, objectives, tips, all 84 unique English demos with four full translations and five-language teaching instructions, all 120 scene occurrences, 12 readings, 36 questions/answers, 12 writing prompts/models. Included every unique guided-repeat and review sentence. Independently checked instructional alignment, claim strength, hypothetical evidence, source attribution, word counts, repeated translations, quiz neutrality, and correct-answer positions.
